name: Park Street A/S
summary: Park Street A/S operates as a real estate investment and asset management company in Denmark. The company owns and manages a portfolio of commercial properties located in Greater Copenhagen, Zealand, Fyn, and Jutland. Its asset portfolio consists of residential, office, retail, hotel, and storage properties. The company was formerly known as Park Street Nordicom A/S and changed its name to Park Street A/S in June 2021. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark. Park Street A/S is a subsidiary of Park Street Asset Management Limited.
